title: Doc metadata embed: a `type: flow` block draws its title and steps in the authored language — the viewer does not read the package's flows translations, and a decision or notify step has no key
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · os-mickey · session_01ASNY8XiE8ZJYbrmzFDtS9g

Found by the hotcrm lane on @objectstack 18.6.0 while verifying hotcrm#2706, which wants the manuals' approval diagrams to be ```` ```metadata ```` embeds instead of hand-drawn mermaid (ADR-0051). The measurements are in the developer's report, hotcrm#2706 comment 7056602749. The code was read on objectstack `main` `8500ee79`.

## What happens

- **Steps:** hotcrm's sales manual embeds `type: flow`, `name: opportunity_approval`. On 18.6.0 it builds, passes `docs/metadata-embed-ref`, and renders. In zh-CN (html `lang="zh-CN"`) the card reads **Large Deal Approval / 流程 / Tiered approval for opportunities: … / Start / Sales Manager Review / High Value (> $500K)? / Sales Director Sign-off / … / End / 已隐藏技术步骤：2**. Only the viewer chrome is translated.
- **The translations exist:** the package ships `flows.opportunity_approval.label: '大额商机审批'` and `flows.opportunity_approval.approvals.manager_review.label: '销售经理审核'` (and `director_signoff`) in its zh-CN pack, with the spec's own keys.
- **The API answers English:** `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/opportunity_approval` gives the same English with no locale, with `Accept-Language: zh-CN`, and with `?locale=zh-CN`. By contrast, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_opportunity` under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` is localized (商机, stage options in Chinese), so a `type: state_machine` embed of the same manual renders in Chinese.

## Why, in code

- **The renderer:** the docs viewer's `FlowView` (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx`) draws `flow.label` and each `n.label` as authored. Nothing there reads the package bundle's `flows.<flow>.*`.
- **Sibling fix:** #34903 (closed 2026-11-17, PR #34947) made the **Studio flow designer** read `flows.<flow>.label` and `flows.<flow>.approvals.<step>.label`. The docs viewer is a different surface and was not covered.
- **The spec:** the `flows.<flow>` translation group has keys for screens, refusals, approvals, notices and records. It has none for a decision, notify, start or end node's display label, so a package cannot ship those at all. #34903 asked "say whether node and edge labels get keys", and the closing PR did not add them.

## Asked

1. The docs viewer's `FlowView` shows the flow label, and every step label the spec lets a package translate, in the reader's locale, falling back to the authored text. This uses the same resolution #34947 gave the Studio designer, or `GET /meta/flow` localized as `GET /meta/object` is.
2. A translation key for any node's display label (decision, notify, start/end included), with an author-time lint like `i18n/missing-flow` for an untranslated step. Alternatively, a ruling that those labels are not translatable, in which case the business view should stop drawing them.

## Done when

A zh-CN reader of a manual that embeds `opportunity_approval` reads 大额商机审批, 销售经理审核 and a Chinese label for each drawn step, with no English step left.

**Dedupe:** searched `metadata viewer flow translation`, `FlowView label locale`, `flow embed translation docs`, `decision node label translation`, `meta flow locale label` and `flows approvals label translation`. The only near match is #34903 (the Studio designer, closed); none covers the docs viewer or node-label keys.

**Reader.** objectstack triage routes it to the owning lane. Not a claim. hotcrm#2706 waits on it.
